scope: Independent review of NEW context/provenance/files continuation only; single-host encrypted local development adapter. No production KMS/cloud/UI approval and no review of unchanged baseline issues.

logic_errors.title: Pending upload does not reserve the owner's shared idempotency namespace

locations.detail: Reservation stores request_key only in files; idempotency remains empty while the transaction is committed and owner lock released.
Existing shared mutation path sees no idempotency row and accepts another endpoint with the same owner/key. This is a new integration regression, not a standalone baseline finding.
Finalization performs blob I/O before inserting the already-consumed idempotency key; uniqueness violation rolls back ready state and outbox.

logic_errors.reproduction: Run the R1 test in evidence/context-review-1/review.test.ts. Pause POST /files after its committed reservation via the supplied afterReservation hook. POST /conversations using the same authenticated owner and idempotency key, then resume the upload.

conflicting_POST_conversations.persisted: New conversation and its idempotency response are committed.

database.files: One pending row, counted against quota
database.idempotency: Same key now permanently caches the conflicting conversation response

observed.filesystem: One encrypted orphan/pending blob exists until startup recovery
observed.after_restart: Recovery removes pending row/blob but the original upload key still returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

expected.conflicting_POST_conversations: 409 idempotency_conflict, no conversation or cache committed for the conflicting operation
expected.original_POST_files: 201 ready with exactly one file.ready event and its own cached idempotent result
expected.retry_POST_files: Original 201 response replayed; no orphan or quota leakage caused by this conflict

logic_errors.remediation_boundary: Reserve/check the shared owner-key namespace across all mutations while an upload is pending; add a regression test. No implementation changes made by reviewer.

observations.title: A second same-host app startup conservatively cancels a live upload in its reservation gap
observations.observed: With the first HTTP upload paused after reservation, a second app using the same DB/root becomes ready, deletes the pending row, and the first upload returns 409 upload_cancelled; only .key remains. No resurrection or false ready result.
observations.expected_for_supported_scope: The documented single-active-instance local lifecycle must be respected; overlapping startups are not coordinated. An already owner-locked put was separately tested: startup waits, then preserves its successfully committed ready file.
observations.classification: Not an additional defect against this explicitly bounded contract: docs/API.md:120 excludes multi-instance coordination. This observation prevents treating startup as live-instance-safe; it is not a request to add distributed infrastructure.

independent_suite.note: Reproduction tests assert the observed defect, so a green test run is not approval.

verification.audit: Not rerun: review forbids network sends. Parent-reported audit result is not independent evidence.
